name: BatchAssetRenamerWindow
src_typeComment: Toolkit/Batch Asset Renamer: select assets in the Project window OR GameObjects in the Hierarchy, type a new base name, and rename all of them in one pass. Tick "Add Numbering" to get "Name - 1", "Name - 2", ... instead of every item getting the identical name (Project-window assets would otherwise get auto-disambiguated by Unity's own " 1"/" 2" suffixing via AssetDatabase.RenameAsset — fine as a fallback, but numbering is the actually-intended feature here; Hierarchy GameObjects don't even get that fallback, since sibling GameObjects are allowed to share an identical name).  Ordering: numbers are assigned by the CURRENT names sorted alphabetically, not by whatever arbitrary order multi-selection happens to report (Unity's Selection order depends on click order, which isn't something a person can predict/reproduce) — so the same selection always numbers the same way no matter how it was selected.  Which window the selection came from changes what renaming actually costs: AssetDatabase.RenameAsset does NOT participate in Unity's Undo stack (asset operations generally don't), so a Project-window rename gets a confirmation dialog warning it can't be undone through Ctrl+Z. A Hierarchy GameObject's name IS a normal serialized property, so Undo.RecordObject covers it fully — Ctrl+Z genuinely reverts it.
